decisions.statement: A settle answers the reading the change leaves beside the entries the change files.
Identity is settled for every page in a write before any relation is.
The shape of every page in a write is settled before any relation is.
The shapes a change leaves are read from bodies the settle composes.
The reading a settle leaves serves those bodies beside the pages the change has.
A relation naming a page of a page type the write has reaches that page type.
A body a file property has is never loaded.
A body that will not load is reported only for a page.
A settle reads an index that is nowhere yet as an index filing nothing.
Which properties have a `unique` is read from the shapes as the change leaves the shapes.
A change turning a property's `unique` on or off files that property for every page there.
A change taking a page type's slug away withdraws every page already of that page type.
The entries a change withdraws are read against the world before the change.
The entries a change files are read against the world the change leaves.
A name the withdrawal cannot resolve is reported rather than passed over.
An edge is withdrawn against where its specifier landed before the change.
The relation filing covers pages the change does not carry.
A change turning a property's key or target refiles the pages of that property's declaring types.
The refusals a change leaves are answered apart from the refusals the world already had.
A page the index cannot read is reported rather than answered as empty.
An importer reread is read as the change leaves that importer rather than off the disk.
The page a name reaches is read as the change leaves that page rather than off the disk.
A change leaving an id under no name refiles the pages naming that id.
A page refiled for more than one reason is refiled once.
A filing answers the lines that came and the lines that went.
The references beside the pages are answered apart from the index's own files.
What each page carries is answered apart from the references and the index.
A page the change writes carries a line for every key that page states.
A page the change takes away is left carrying nothing.
What a page carries is written whole rather than laid over what the file holds.
A page that moves carries at its new path everything it carried at the old.
A reference filing names a path against the repository rather than the index.
No reference is filed beside a path the change has taken the page from.
The references file beside a page the change takes from a path goes with the page.
An importer the change has not repointed files no reference where the page was.
A page moving takes to its new place the names it had at its old place.
A name from a page the settle refiles is left out of what moves that way.
An import is not taken that way, a name reaching a page by id and an import by path.
The reading a settle leaves has the references that settle files.
No entry file is read to work a filing out.
A file whose lines a filing leaves as they were is not filed.
No settle refuses a world for what the index that settle reads has not filed.
A settle into an index that has filed nothing yet files nothing and refuses none.
Nothing a settle writes says the index is whole.
A world only a settle has written is read as an index that is missing.
